title: Email preference for optional mail
summary: Optional emails, such as Recruitment decisions, now go only to people who turned on Email in their contact preferences.
changes: Send Recruitment decision emails only when the applicant has Email turned on in their contact preferences.
Keep sending sign-in, security, and service emails, such as password resets and ticket updates, whatever the preference.
Explain on the profile page which emails the Email preference covers.
version_rationale: Patch on the 0.42 line: honours an existing preference for optional emails only.
validation: Recruitment lifecycle, mail, and profile tests.
composer pre-merge on the pull request branch.
known_limitations: Applicants who never turned Email on stop receiving Recruitment decision emails; they still see decisions on their application page.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. No database change is involved.
